children: The National Stock Exchange of India has cut the size of its long-awaited IPO by more than 15% and will take investor orders next week, in what is slated to be one of India's biggest listings, its prospectus showed on Thursday.
Existing investors including State Bank of India
and Canada Pension Plan Investment Board will now sell 126.4 million shares, below the 148.91 million shares planned earlier.
The share sale will open for subscription on September 17 and close on September 21, with anchor investor bidding scheduled for September 16, NSE said in a filing.
